task_completion.description: Load the crystal structure PDB:1URN into the molecular viewer.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The PDB ID '1URN' or the structure of the U1A-RNA complex is visible in the PyMOL object menu or viewer window.

task_completion.description: Select and display Tyr13, Phe56 (Chain A) and the stacking RNA bases (Chain B) as sticks.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Specific residues (Y13, F56) and RNA bases are rendered in 'stick' representation in the viewer.

task_completion.description: Perform distance measurements between the aromatic rings of Tyr13/Phe56 and the corresponding RNA bases.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Dashed lines representing distance measurements with numerical labels (in Angstroms) are visible between the protein sidechains and RNA bases.

task_completion.description: Save a high-quality image of the stacking interactions to the specified path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A command or file dialog shows the image being saved to '~/PyMOL_Data/images/u1a_rna_stacking.png'.

task_completion.description: Create a text report identifying the specific RNA bases and the measured distances.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal output shows a report containing the names of the RNA bases (A10 and U13) and their distances to Tyr13 and Phe56.

integrity.description: The agent used the PyMOL GUI or command line interface to manipulate the molecule rather than just viewing a static image.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show active selection, rotation, or command entry within the PyMOL interface.

integrity.description: The distances reported were actually measured in the software, not hallucinated.
integrity.visual_evidence: The distance labels visible in the PyMOL viewport match the values written in the text report.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply output the answer without loading the structure.
integrity.visual_evidence: The trajectory shows the sequential process of loading the file, selecting residues, and then performing measurements.

privileged_info_for_vlm: In PDB 1URN, Tyr13 (Chain A) pi-stacks with Adenine 10 (Chain B, residue A10), and Phe56 (Chain A) pi-stacks with Uracil 13 (Chain B, residue U13). Typical heavy-atom distances for these stacking interactions are approximately 3.4 to 3.9 Angstroms.
